Добавление в друзья само по себе не откр: Adding a friend does not open your trips. Participant access depends on invitations and travel dates; photo sources require the owner’s approval.
Гостевая ссылка открывает всю опубликова: A guest link opens the entire published trip to anyone who has it. You can replace or disable it. Photos already viewed or downloaded cannot be taken back.
Публичный профиль показывает имя, юзерне: A public profile shows a name, username and avatar. Only the profile owner can access settings, contact details, friends and requests.
Улицы и районы определяются по координат: Streets and neighbourhoods are identified using coordinates and OpenStreetMap data. Descriptions and images come from Wikipedia: Russian articles with an English fallback, or English articles when the interface is in English.
Для геопоиска внешние сервисы получают п: Geographic search sends approximate areas and rounded coordinates to external services. Photo files and Yandex Disk tokens are not sent to place-search services. Maps and articles depend on external sources being available.
Миниатюры и найденные места сохраняются: Thumbnails and discovered places are cached for faster repeat visits. Signing out clears your private browser cache.
QuestKeeps развивается из личного архива: QuestKeeps is growing from a personal archive into a space for shared memories. Start with one trip, a few photos and the people you want to share them with.
